name: Names Of Jesus
overview: The names of Jesus reveal His divine nature and redemptive mission as revealed in Scripture. Isaiah 9:6 proclaims Him as Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, and Prince of Peace, emphasizing His sovereign authority and eternal deity. Matthew affirms His role as Savior who delivers His people from sin (1:21) and as Emmanuel, God with us (1:23), highlighting His incarnation. Peter’s confession in Matthew 16:16 identifies Jesus as the Christ, the Son of the living God, while John’s Gospel declares Him both the eternal Word who was with God and was God (1:1) and the Word made flesh dwelling among us (1:14), underscoring His unique personhood and grace.
